title: How She Found Out They Were Real Cops
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On August 5, 2023, police in Eau Claire, WI were called to a bar and grill where a known disruptive female patron was refusing to leave and causing a disturbance. The officers, aware of her history of combative behavior, found her behaving strangely and intoxicated. She had open cases that required sobriety. When they tried to arrest her, she resisted loudly, resulting in her taking on a taco-shaped appearance.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
